relationships.subject: LC-PVA-ACC circuit
relationships.evidence_quote: Under inflammatory pain conditions, activation of the LC-PVA-ACC circuits evoked greater ACC firing

relationships.subject: CFA
relationships.evidence_quote: Complete Freund's adjuvant led to enhanced c-Fos expression in locus coeruleus, PVA, and ACC

key_findings: LC reaches ACC via monosynaptic and polysynaptic LC-PVA-ACC routes; the latter drives stronger ACC firing under inflammatory pain.
LC-PVA-ACC manipulation modulates pain sensitivity more strongly than direct LC-ACC.
